# gfopentls.library API headers

The public headers of gfopentls.library, API version 1, from
DalsinAI/gfopentls main (commit aa6f6a5, 2 November 2026), unchanged.
MIT licensed and free, Copyright (c) 2026 AmiCradle Team (`LICENSE`).
The engine's native transport (gfopenservice's `src/wfnet_amiga.c`, which
includes `libraries/gfopentls.h` and `proto/gfopentls.h`) is built against
them; the library itself is opened at run time, never linked.
`third_party/opentls` keeps the older opentls.library headers for
OpenBrowser Lite.
